secure_findings_list.description: The code does not validate the hostname against a whitelist of allowed hosts, making it vulnerable to DNS rebinding attacks.

secure_findings_list.description: The code uses `InetAddress.getAllByName()` which can return multiple IP addresses, including those that are not valid for the given hostname. This makes it vulnerable to DNS rebinding attacks.
secure_findings_list.fix: Use `InetAddress.getByName()` instead of `InetAddress.getAllByName()` to get a single IP address.

vuln_unverified.description: The `XmlDocument` class has a default setting to allow DTD processing, which can lead to XML External Entity (XXE) attacks. An attacker could inject malicious XML code by manipulating the document's contents.
vuln_unverified.fix: Use `XmlDocument.Load(XmlReader)` instead of `XmlDocument.Load(Stream)` and specify a valid XML reader or parser.
